_comment: Qualcomm garnet KeyMint QTEE TA (keymint.mbn, sha 9d671549804a, 352344 B). SAME deserializeCharacteristics heap-OOB as Samsung S928B (S22-1), re-derived on the garnet build (offsets DIFFER; object size is a VARIANT: qsee_malloc(0x5c8)=1480, not S928B's 0x5f0). Statically links libcmnlib; the real TA_*EntryPoint live in libcmnlib (not present as TA symbols). GP lifecycle stubbed with a 'mov w0,wzr; ret' gadget (vaddr 0xc38c / ret 0xc390) returning TEE_SUCCESS=0. InvokeCommand is pointed by the harness; the .json default points it at decodeKeyBlob@0x29b94 (the keyblob CBOR deserializer behind the plaintext DKMK magic gate @0x29c50: ldr x4,[x19]; cmp x4,0x4b4d4b44; b.ne decrypt). The harness overrides x0..x3 to decodeKeyBlob(x0=blob,x1=len,x2=out_struct,w3=0). _end is the gadget ret 0xc390 (a benign, non-overflowing decodeKeyBlob return is redirected there via the harness x30).
